title: A sprint item that rewords a doc the goal research's tested rows quote carries the _self eval file in its touches
goal: precheck warns of each committed item whose touches name a kb/_self doc that an eval row added by the sprint's goal research story (a commit carrying its KB-Work) names in expect_paths and lack the _self eval file, so a reworded line moves its row in the same item and not at the landing's rag.py eval (SP-djl7za6x: BG-geepi6yv rewrote tools.md's section-window sentence and its land stopped at rag.py eval on two rows ST-5jqqzrgy had just added)

gates.question: Which eval rows does precheck read to decide that a committed item's doc is quoted by the goal research's tested rows: only the rows added by commits carrying the research story's KB-Work (known once it has landed, so precheck is rerun then), or every row of the _self eval file that names the doc in expect_paths (known at planning, but it warns of nearly every _self doc item and puts the shared eval file in many items' touches)?
options: rows added by the research story
gates.recommendation: rows added by the research story
gates.answer: rows added by the research story

gates.question: How does precheck read the rows the goal research story added: from its KB-Work commits on HEAD (rows a commit has that its first parent's eval file lacks), or from the sprint's eval file against origin/main?
options: commits carrying the research story's KB-Work
gates.recommendation: commits carrying the research story's KB-Work

notes:
Gate g1 answered rows added by the research story (recommended): the rows are known once the research has landed, so the orchestrator reruns precheck then (ST-me3dmaxy, which depends on this item); reading every row that names a doc would warn of nearly every _self doc item and put the shared eval file in many touches. The test extends an existing land e2e test, as the ceiling leaves no id for a new one.
Premise: _tools/bl_land.py and _tools/bl_plan.py hold no lookup_eval reference (grep count 0 in both), so precheck reads no eval row and warns of no sibling whose doc a research row quotes. Run at planning: the check exits 2 (the selector collects no test).
Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 10 of 15, "Research and content workers: sweep contradicted lines, check DER facts, keep anchors and eval rows in scope"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
